transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Um... I guess I'm just having some trouble at work. I do bookkeeping, and... I can't really stop going back over the same spreadsheets. Just checking the calculations again and again. 

Sometimes I end up staying for hours after everyone else leaves. I know I already checked them, but... I just feel like if I don't do it one more time... um, something bad will happen. And it'll be my fault.
Do you have any thoughts that keep repeating in your mind, even when you try to focus on something else?

Yeah... I do. Um. Even after I check and know the numbers match, I just... I keep having this thought that I missed some hidden mistake. Like in the payroll, or the taxes. 

I try to push it away so I can focus on other things, but it just comes right back. Just... thinking that somebody's check won't go through, or the firm will get in trouble. It's... I don't know. It's like I can't trust my own eyes.
Do you feel like you have to perform any specific rituals or actions in a certain way to reduce your anxiety about making mistakes?

Um... no. Not really. 

I don't... I don't have any rituals or anything like that. I just... I just keep checking the spreadsheets like I said. That's... that's all I do.
Do you find yourself repeating any behaviors or mental acts outside of your work with the spreadsheets?

Um... no. Not really. I don't think so. 

Just... mostly just the work stuff. When I'm at home I just... I don't know, I just try to rest. I haven't really noticed anything else.
Do you feel anxious when you're not working or thinking about work?
Um... not really. I mean... I guess I just try to relax when I'm not at work. I don't really think about it much.
How much distress do these repeating thoughts about missing mistakes cause you?

Um... a lot, I guess. It's just... hard. 

Even after I know the numbers match, this thought just... it keeps jumping in. Like I missed one hidden mistake in the payroll, or the taxes. And I start thinking somebody's check won't go through, or... or the firm will get in trouble. 

I try to push it away, but... I don't know. It just comes right back. It's like I can't even trust my own eyes. So... yeah. It bothers me a lot.
Have these thoughts or behaviors about checking your work affected your relationships with friends or family?

Um... I guess... I don't really have a lot of time for people lately. 

I haven't been going to choir practice. Or... the youth center. I used to volunteer there, but I just... I can't seem to leave the office on time anymore. I'm always stuck checking things. 

And, um... work hasn't been great either. I... I missed a filing deadline recently. Because I was checking. They called me into a formal meeting about it. So... yeah. It's affecting things.
Have you noticed any problems in your daily life, outside of work, because of these thoughts about mistakes or your need to keep checking?
Um... no, not really. Just... what I already said. About not having time for things because I'm at the office. But other than that... I don't think so.
Are there any things you feel you must do, or do over and over, when you're not working or thinking about work?
Um... no. I don't think so. It's... it's really just the work stuff. When I'm not doing that, I just... no, nothing else comes to mind.
Are there things that you feel compelled to do in a specific way when you're not at work?
Um... no. Not really. I mean, I don't... I just go home and try to rest. There's nothing special I have to do. Just normal stuff.
Have you felt like your need to keep checking your work has significantly interfered with your overall quality of life?

Um... I guess so. I mean... I missed a filing deadline recently. They called me into a formal meeting about it at work. And... I don't really do much else anymore. I've stopped going to my choir rehearsals, and... the youth-center stuff I used to help with. I just... I can't get out of the office on time to make it to any of it.
Do you think your checking behaviors are reasonable, or do you feel like they're excessive?

Um... I guess they're excessive. I just... I can't stop going back over the same spreadsheets and calculations. Again and again. Even when I know I already checked them. I end up staying at work for hours after everyone else leaves because... I don't know, if I don't do it just one more time, I get this feeling like something bad is going to happen. And... that it'll be my fault. So I just keep doing it.
Do you feel like you're checking the spreadsheets because you're afraid of making a specific mistake, or is it more that you just feel like everything needs to be a certain way?

Um... a mistake, I guess. Like... even after I know the numbers match, this thought just keeps jumping in. That I missed some hidden mistake... in payroll, or taxes. And I just think somebody's check won't go through, or... the firm will get in trouble. I try to push it away. I really do. But it comes right back. It's just... like I can't trust my own eyes.
Do you feel like the spreadsheets or the numbers need to be arranged or look a certain way for you to consider them correct?
Um... no. Not really. It doesn't matter how they look. I just... I just have to make sure the math is right.
Do you feel like the numbers or the spreadsheets have to be perfect in any way beyond just being mathematically correct?
Um... no. Not really. Just... making sure there aren't any mistakes. Like I said. That's all I'm looking for.
Have you considered seeking help for these thoughts and behaviors because they are interfering with your life?

Um... yeah. I guess so. It's just... causing problems now. I, um... I actually missed a filing deadline recently. They called me into a formal meeting about it at work. And... I've stopped making it to my choir rehearsals. And the youth center. I just... I can never get out of the office on time anymore.
